title: Compiled Objective
description: The output of the objective-compilation skill: one Objective decomposed into a validated Work Item graph, ready for graph.ts to apply to GitHub as an issue, sub-issues, and 'blocked by' dependencies (§3). This is a compiler artifact, not a stored Factory concept -- once graph.ts has applied it, GitHub is the only remaining source of truth (§3's 'no custom fields, no state labels, no sidecar files').

title.description: The Objective issue's title, unchanged from the human-authored Objective (§4's Objective is read, not rewritten, by the loop).

workItems.description: Every Work Item this Objective decomposes into. Order is not meaningful -- readiness (§3) is derived from each item's `dependsOn`, not array position.
